issue: Deformation cloud viewer returned 404 Not Found in production core mode
rootCause: The calculation stage-result artifact router was registered only in full product mode, while production systemd services force PITGUARD_PRODUCT_MODE=core.
fixes: Register calculation artifact and stage-chunk routes in core mode
Load viewer chunks quietly without global blocking overlay
Bound viewer hydration to eight chunks and fall back to latest authoritative calculation evidence
Render cloud cells along the complete wall polyline instead of the first-to-last chord
Show an explicit geometry-only placeholder when calculated samples are unavailable
Render non-blocking read failures as a short local notification
